text: もし　かてたら　ドアが　ひらいて　おくの　へやに　すすめるわ！

structure.jp: おくの　へやに　すすめるわ！
structure.en: you can go on to the room beyond!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' that thing happens; もし in front makes the 'if' clearer. かてたら = 'if you are able to win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to the える sound means 'can do'. The same change is inside かてたら. すすめる = 'can go on'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one happening to the next, like 'and'. ドアが　ひらいて = 'the door opens, and'.
